title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support Measures ¿ EU Cooperation Facility and Strategic Communication in Vietnam

description.narrative: This action covers two facilities, namely the Cooperation Facility ¿ Technical Assistance and the Cooperation Facility - Strategic Communication and Public Diplomacy, in line with ARES note Ares(2024)3816171 on the transfer of responsibilities for the programming and implementation of the Support Measures appropriations to EU Delegations in Asia and the Pacific.The Cooperation Facility ¿ Technical Assistance (EUR 2 million) will enhance the efficiency, performance, and impact of EU programs in Vietnam. It provides the Delegation with the flexibility to finance small-scale activities required to achieve the objectives of the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI-Global Europe) as outlined in the MIP priority areas. It will notably support the design of MIP projects in a Team Europe approach from 2026 onwards, as well as provide necessary administrative or technical assistance for programming and managing actions. It will also assist the Delegation in policy dialogue with various stakeholders, and covering additional sectors such as higher education, skills development, research, and innovation. The Cooperation Facility - Strategic Communication and Public Diplomacy (EUR 3 million) activities will be designed to raise awareness, understanding and perception of the EU and its partnership with Vietnam, in line with the priorities identified in the MIP, in particular through Global Gateway flagships and Team Europe initiatives and programmes. Strategic Communication and Public Diplomacy campaigns will serve to strengthen EU¿s position as a trusted and reliable partner of reference for Vietnam. An increased alignment of EU communication with EU foreign policies will significantly enhance the visibility and understanding of the EU relations and partnership with Vietnam. This component is expected to start in 2026 and will build on the already ongoing Strategic Communication and Public Diplomacy action, funded from the first part of the MIP and contracted in 2024.
